image_description: A side-view digital rendering of a Triceratops dinosaur against a white background. The image focuses on the torso, hindquarters, and rear legs, with the head partially visible on the right edge showing the frill and brow horn base. The skin texture is detailed with scales and reddish-brown mottling.
